newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Gas files for 2 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Gas files for 2 mln shr offer.

text.p: Virginia Gas Co said Friday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of two million shares.

The company said it plans to use the proceeds for the development of transmission pipelines, expansion of a storage facility, expansion of propane distribution systems in southwestern Virginia, and development of exploaration and production facilities.
The offering is being managed by Ferris, Baker Watts Inc.
